turns.content: I'm looking for a confident, professional LinkedIn post about the Fujifilm X100VI. It’s a compact camera with a hybrid viewfinder and a 23mmF2 lens. Keep it under 80 words, please.

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI, a compact camera that combines convenience with high-quality performance. Featuring a unique hybrid viewfinder, it allows for an exceptional shooting experience. The 23mmF2 lens captures stunning images with remarkable clarity. Elevate your photography with the X100VI today!
